name: Do I need a permit for pathway lighting installation in Pasadena?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for pathway lighting installation in Pasadena?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Pasadena, as with many municipalities, permits for outdoor lighting installations can be required depending on the scope and type of the project. Minor, low-voltage installations that don't involve significant electrical work or structural changes often don't require a permit. However, projects that involve new permanent electrical circuits, significant trenching, or fixtures that are hard-wired into the main electrical panel typically do require permits to ensure compliance with local building codes and safety regulations. It's always recommended to consult with our team or the Pasadena Building and Safety Division directly to confirm specific requirements before beginning any work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits in Pasadena may be needed for significant electrical work or hard-wired systems, but often not for minor low-voltage installations. Always consult with us or local authorities.
